text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today, we already use "narrow AI" for tasks like translation and recommendations. But many researchers want to create Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) — a machine that can learn and think like a human. AGI could bring huge benefits, such as curing diseases and solving climate problems. However, there are also serious risks, including job loss and safety concerns. Some scientists predict AGI may arrive within 20 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but one thing is clear: the future of AI will affect everyone.
